$('wx').addEventListener('click',closeWin);$('mute').addEventListener('click',function(){if(cur){muteAI(cur);winRender()}});$('rm').addEventListener('click',function(){var s=cur;if(!s||AI.length<=1)return;closeWin();setTimeout(function(){removeAI(s)},420)});scrim.addEventListener('click',closeWin);

$('no').addEventListener('click',function(){if(cur){cur.ask=0;cur.work=0;cur.prog=0;cur.last='';cur.wait=6}});
var atts=[];
function renderAtt(){var el=$('att');el.innerHTML='';atts.forEach(function(a,i){var d=document.createElement('span');d.className='ac';if(a.url){var im=document.createElement('img');im.alt='';im.src=a.url;d.appendChild(im)}else{var em=document.createElement('em');em.textContent=(a.name.split('.').pop()||'').slice(0,4).toUpperCase();d.appendChild(em)}
var t=document.createElement('span');t.textContent=a.name;d.appendChild(t);var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+a.name);b.innerHTML='&times;';b.addEventListener('click',function(){if(a.url)try{URL.revokeObjectURL(a.url)}catch(e){}atts.splice(atts.indexOf(a),1);renderAtt()});d.appendChild(b);el.appendChild(d)})}
function addFiles(list){Array.prototype.forEach.call(list||[],function(f){if(atts.length>=4)return;var u='';try{if(f.type&&f.type.indexOf('image/')===0)u=URL.createObjectURL(f)}catch(e){}atts.push({name:f.name,url:u})});renderAtt()}
function clearAtts(){atts.forEach(function(a){if(a.url)try{URL.revokeObjectURL(a.url)}catch(e){}});atts=[];renderAtt()}
$('pl').addEventListener('click',function(){$('file').click()});
$('file').addEventListener('change',function(){addFiles(this.files);this.value=''});
win.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){e.preventDefault()});
win.addEventListener('drop',function(e){e.preventDefault();addFiles(e.dataTransfer&&e.dataTransfer.files)});
$('in').addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var v=$('inp').value.trim();if((!v&&!atts.length)||!cur)return;give(cur,v||'Review attachments',atts.length?' +'+atts.length:'');$('inp').value='';clearAtts();winRender()});
AI.forEach(render);renderSum();
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){var hinted=0;new IntersectionObserver(function(e){if(e[0].isIntersecting&&!document.hidden){run();if(!hinted){hinted=1;setTimeout(function(){var r=AI.filter(function(x){return !x.mute})[0];if(!r)return;r.el.classList.add('hint');setTimeout(function(){r.el.classList.remove('hint')},2100)},900)}}else pause()}).observe(stage)}else run();
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){document.hidden?pause():run()});
})();
</script>
